description: This Java source file defines the class LiteralDData, which provides access to distributed data of literal topics within an Akka actor system. It includes methods to instantiate the class, retrieve data readers and writers, create subscriptions, and defines an abstract provider class for configuration.

classes.name: LiteralDData
classes.description: Provides access to distributed data for literal topics using Akka's distributed data extension, including methods to instantiate, read, write, and subscribe to data.

classes.name: LiteralDData.Provider
classes.description: An abstract static class serving as a provider for distributed data configuration, to be implemented at user sites.

methods.name: LiteralDData.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of LiteralDData with a given actor system and provider.

methods.name: LiteralDData.of
methods.description: Factory method to create an instance of LiteralDData with a given handler extension.

methods.name: LiteralDData.getReader
methods.description: Returns the data reader associated with this distributed data instance.

methods.name: LiteralDData.getWriter
methods.description: Returns the data writer associated with this distributed data instance.

methods.name: LiteralDData.createSubscriptions
methods.description: Creates a new instance of subscriptions for LiteralUpdate data.
